choice_policy: Exactly one value per episode: ['paint','source'][seed % 2]. Two consecutive seeds cover both settings.
input_domain: Four deterministic strict-valid scenes from the selected generator: three public-profile geometries and one shallow extrapolation, with fixed difficulty/profile/orientation controls and independently drawn role palettes.
lesson_policy: Three demonstrations followed by one query; also test all four single-query rotations against the other parameter value.
limitations: Two consecutive seeds and one declared rival per episode only. The prototype proves executable labels and local identifiability on this bounded sample; it does not prove broad curriculum value.

copy_color_role.meaning: Color used for reflected terrain: marker/paint role or source/terrain role.

scope: Proposed task-local parametric extension only; not a canonical rule change, production approval, or generator-axis approval.
